title: Homura Vitality Enchantment
description: About the Enchantment of maximum health
body:
This content was translated by AI.

Added a new enchantment called "Vitality" that increases maximum health in Minecraft.

How to obtain: Enchanting Table (on helmets, chestplates, leggings, or boots), Villager trades, or Fishing.

Applicable armor pieces: Helmet, Chestplate, Leggings, Boots.

Maximum level: V (5)

Effect: Increases the wearer's maximum health when enchanted.
